_doc: Townsfolk sickness (systems/illness.js): the people of every town with a roster (settlement.folk) fall ill, pass it on, are nursed and doctored, and recover or die. Each case lives on the person (p.ill = { k, d caught, on symptoms, end, sv severity 0..1, care, visits, by }); immunity on p.imm = { k: until-day (-1 for life) }; the town's outbreaks, the player's funded physician and alms on folk.ill; a town summary (share sick, abed, worst illness) on settlement.sickness, read by world/townLabour.js (hands at work), the street map and the talk. Steps every stepDays on the town's own hash stream (never the shared RNG). Each illness: ailment = the player's disease of the same kind in data/ailments.json (caught from the sick); spont = a person's own chance a day (by risk), contagion = the force a sick person puts on each one they live, work or mingle with (a day); incubation, days = [min,max] days; abed = share of cases laid up in bed (the worst); mortality = deaths per case by age band before care; season multipliers; immunityDays (-1 for life). Risk (how likely to catch it and how hard it goes): age, hunger (a dearth), station (beggar to noble), household crowding, the town's size, its wealth (clean water, a bathhouse), alms. Care at the end of a course (multiplies the death chance): family at home, the town's physician or herbalist (its best hand at Medicine, a fee from the family's purse to the healer's, herbs out of the town's market and paid into its purse), the priest's charity, wealth, a gift from the player. baseShare: with sickness on, the age mortality of systems/townsfolk.js keeps only this share (accidents, failing hearts, old age); the rest of the dying is this sim's.

old: a long sleep in the night

travel._doc: Between towns: each step a town with sick folk may pass a case to each town within radius hexes (perStep × its share of contagious cases × the contagion × the other town's size, falling with distance); plague × plague. A realm under quarantine (the Pestilence law: data/laws.json) lets quarantine of it through, in or out. A town with no roster keeps an abstract settlement.sickness for days.

quarantineTrade._doc: Quarantine cuts trade too (systems/marketDynamics.js): a market link to or from a town shut by quarantine (the Pestilence law in its realm and sickness in it: Illness.townSickness closed) moves only `imports` of its goods, and only `caravans` of its embodied traders take the road (a hash of the link and the day).

fund._doc: The player pays a physician to go round the town's sick for days (the gold a pool: each visit's fee to the healer's purse, its herbs bought from the town's market into its purse; what is left when the days run out the healer keeps), or gives alms (the coin into the poorest households' purses; they eat better: risk × alms for days).
fund._karma: Karma for paying the healer or giving alms comes only for real charity: when at least karmaMinNeedy are sick (the healer) or poor (alms) here, and once per fund's month — paying again while it runs tops up the pool and earns none.

cold: *sniffs* Forgive me — I've a cold coming on.
*coughs into a sleeve* Just a cold. It'll pass.
fever: *shivering* I've a fever on me. You'd best not stand too close.
I'm burning up... I shouldn't be out of bed.
flux: My guts are griping something terrible. The water, I think.
*pale* The flux. Don't drink from the well by the tannery.
consumption: *a long, rattling cough* It's my chest. It has been for a while now.
I'm not as strong as I was. This cough...
pox: Keep back! I've the pox on me.
*scratching at the pocks* It itches like fire.
wound_fever: The wound's gone hot. The herbalist says it's turned.
*sweating* That cut went bad on me.
childbed: *weakly* The baby is well. It's me that is not.
I've not been right since the birth.
plague: *gasping* Get away from me... the plague...
It's in me. The swellings came this morning.

kinSick: My {kin} {name} is down with {illness}. I'm sick with worry.
{name} — my {kin} — has {illness}. We pray it breaks soon.
healer: Let's have a look at you.
Keep them warm and give them broth.
The fever should break by morning, gods willing.
Who else in this house is poorly?
fear: Don't touch anything. They say it's in the air.
Shut your door and burn rosemary.
The gods have turned their faces from us.
quarantine: The gates are shut. No one in or out, by order of the crown.
Turn back — this town is under quarantine.
thanks: Bless you. Bless you for this.
You didn't have to do this. Thank you.
The gods see what you've done.
